document.title: Artificial intelligence and jobs
document.question:
Some people believe that artificial intelligence will create more new jobs than it destroys. Others fear that it will leave millions of people without work.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
